member.name: T:CometEngine::InterpolationMode
member.summary: Controls how a rigid body's Transform is visually interpolated between fixed physics steps.

member.name: F:CometEngine::InterpolationMode::NONE
member.summary: No interpolation; the transform is shown at its last physics position.

member.name: F:CometEngine::InterpolationMode::INTERPOLATE
member.summary: Smoothly interpolate the transform between the previous and current physics positions.

member.name: F:CometEngine::InterpolationMode::EXTRAPOLATE
member.summary: Extrapolate the transform forward from the current physics position using its velocity.
